summary: Phase 2G.2 Web Push (VAPID) backend testing completed. All push notification endpoints working correctly with proper auth, validation, auto-cleanup, audit logging, and security. Regression tests confirm existing endpoints work with zero push subscriptions.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 422 instead of 400 for missing 'keys' field
minor_issues.impact: Minimal - FastAPI/Pydantic standard behavior for validation errors. Endpoint correctly rejects invalid input.
minor_issues.note: This is standard FastAPI behavior (422 Unprocessable Entity for validation errors). Not a bug, just different from expected 400 Bad Request.

passed_tests: GET /api/push/config - public endpoint returns VAPID public key and enabled flag
GET /api/push/status - auth required, returns accurate subscription status
POST /api/push/subscribe - auth required, validates keys (p256dh, auth), upserts properly
POST /api/push/unsubscribe - auth required, removes only caller's subscriptions
POST /api/push/test - auth required, sends test push and returns delivery stats
Auto-cleanup: Dead subscriptions (404/410) automatically deleted from database
Audit logging: Push notifications logged with channel='push', direction='outbound'
Security: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY never exposed in any API response
Regression: All 7 demo user logins working (super_admin, fleet_admin, driver, marcus, aaliyah, tyler, rosa)
Regression: GET /api/drivers works with zero push subscriptions
Regression: GET /api/notifications/status works with zero push subscriptions
Regression: POST /api/crash-events works with zero push subscriptions (push fan-out doesn't break flow)
Regression: POST /api/roadside/dispatch works with zero push subscriptions
Regression: POST /api/dispatch/sms works with zero push subscriptions
Regression: POST /api/test/sms-inbound works and triggers push to admins (when subscriptions exist)
Phase 2C: GET /api/notifications/status - Twilio and SendGrid configured correctly
Phase 2C: GET /api/notifications/logs - Audit logs include SMS, email, and push channels

success_percentage.backend: 98% (40/41 tests passed - 1 minor validation status code difference)
